title.en: Aspect in depth: past, future, imperative, negation

card: **Past**: perfective for a result, imperfective for a process, habit or "have you ever". **Imperative**: perfective for a one-off request (**Закро́йте окно́**), imperfective for invitations, instructions in progress and prohibitions (**Сади́тесь!**, **Не закрыва́йте!**). **Negation** usually pulls towards the imperfective.

sections.title: Past: result versus fact
sections.body:
- **Result** that matters now: **Я потеря́л ключи́.** (*I've lost my keys*: they're still lost.)
- **Process or duration**: **Я два часа́ иска́л ключи́.**
- **Repetition**: **Он ча́сто теря́л ключи́.**
- **General fact**, *did it ever happen?*: **Ты чита́л Толсто́го?** (*Have you read Tolstoy?*) The question is about the experience, not a finished task.
- **Annulled result** (did and undid): **Я открыва́л окно́** means *I opened the window (and it's closed again now)*. Compare **Я откры́л окно́** (*it's open now*).

sections.title: Imperative
sections.body:
- A one-off concrete request: perfective. **Дай мне ру́чку, пожа́луйста.** **Позвони́ ма́ме.**
- A polite invitation or encouragement to start (often with guests): imperfective. **Сади́тесь!** **Проходи́те!** **Бери́те, не стесня́йтесь!**
- Instructions about *how* to do something already under way: imperfective. **Чита́йте ме́дленнее.**
- **Prohibition** with **не**: imperfective. **Не открыва́й окно́!** **Не опа́здывайте!**
- **Warning** against an accident with **не**: perfective. **Не упади́!** (*Don't fall!*) **Не забу́дь!** (*Don't forget!*)

sections.title: Negation
sections.body:
- **не на́до / не ну́жно / не сто́ит** + imperfective: **Не на́до звони́ть.** (*No need to call.*)
- **нельзя́** + imperfective = *not allowed*: **Здесь нельзя́ кури́ть.** **нельзя́** + perfective = *impossible*: **Э́ту дверь нельзя́ откры́ть.** (*It can't be opened.*)
- In the past, **не** + perfective means the expected result didn't happen: **Я не сдал экза́мен.** (*I failed it.*) **не** + imperfective means the action didn't take place at all: **Я не сдава́л экза́мен.** (*I didn't sit it.*)

sections.title: Verbs of beginning and ending
sections.body: **начина́ть / нача́ть**, **конча́ть / ко́нчить**, **продолжа́ть**, **перестава́ть / переста́ть**, **устава́ть / уста́ть** are always followed by an **imperfective** infinitive: **Я на́чал чита́ть.** **Он переста́л кури́ть.** The beginning or end is the completed event; the activity itself is a process.
In the imperative, perfective is *a task*, imperfective is *an attitude*. **Откро́й окно́** gives a task; **Открыва́й!** says "go on, open it, what are you waiting for".

mistakes.why: *Have you ever* asks about experience: imperfective.

examples.en: There's no need to buy anything.
